info.name: Sanad App — Community and feedback
info.description: Authenticated Community reads/writes, check-ins, ratings, and app feedback. Posts are moderated before publication. Use Sanad.local.postman_environment.json and supply a disposable access token.

variable.description: Author id to block or unblock. It must be a REGISTERED author id - take it from a non-anonymous post, because an anonymous post never publishes its author id.

item.name: List published posts
item.description: Authenticated read. Only Published posts are returned. Optional filters: search (case-insensitive titles+contents), categoryId, fromDate/toDate (UTC creation, inclusive), sort=Newest|Oldest|MostLiked (default Newest; other values return 400 Community.InvalidSort). Items carry additive per-user fields categoryId, categoryArabicName, categoryEnglishName, isLiked, isFavorited, currentUserRating, plus the author fields displayName (English full name, Arabic fallback, null when the identity row is missing) and avatarUrl (the author's avatar download path /api/v1/community/authors/{authorId}/photo when the author has a stored avatar, else null - never the stored private key). An anonymous post carries no author identity: displayName and avatarUrl are null and the response has no author id.

item.name: List favorites
item.description: Caller's favorited published posts, newest-favorited-first. Same post shape (incl. per-user and author fields) as the posts feed.

item.name: Get published post
item.description: Unknown or pending/rejected posts return 404. Response includes additive per-user fields (isLiked, isFavorited, currentUserRating), category fields, and the author fields displayName and avatarUrl. An anonymous post carries no author identity: displayName and avatarUrl are null and the response has no author id.

item.name: Create post (pending review)

body.raw:
{
  "titleArabic": "نصيحة يومية",
  "titleEnglish": "Daily care tip",
  "contentArabic": "تذكّر شرب الماء.",
  "contentEnglish": "Remember to drink water.",
  "imageUrl": null,
  "isAnonymous": false,
  "categoryId": null
}

item.description: The author comes from the JWT. Success creates PendingReview; capture the returned id for moderation. categoryId is optional; unknown ids return 400 Community.InvalidCategory and inactive categories return 409 Community.CategoryInactive.

item.name: Update my own post — disposable fixture only

body.raw:
{
  "titleArabic": "نصيحة يومية محدثة",
  "titleEnglish": "Updated daily care tip",
  "contentArabic": "تذكّر شرب الماء بانتظام.",
  "contentEnglish": "Remember to drink water regularly.",
  "imageUrl": null,
  "isAnonymous": false,
  "categoryId": null
}

item.description: STATE-CHANGING: only the authenticated author may edit their own PendingReview or Published post. Published edits return to PendingReview. Author identity is immutable and never accepted from the body. Unknown/foreign/deleted → 404; rejected/archived or stale lifecycle write → 409; invalid fields/image → 400. Use an approved disposable fixture.

item.name: Delete my own post — disposable fixture only
item.description: STATE-CHANGING: only the authenticated author can delete their own post; retained soft-deletion returns 204, repeat/foreign/unknown returns 404. Comments and referenced media remain stored. Use an approved disposable fixture.

item.name: Report published post
item.description: Authenticated Community user only; published posts only and authors cannot report their own post. reasonCode is Spam|HarassmentOrAbuse|HarmfulOrUnsafeContent|MisleadingOrFalseInformation|Other; Other requires a note. Notes are trimmed plain text up to 1000 characters. A repeat returns the retained report; reporting does not hide the post. Own/non-published target returns 409; unknown post returns 404.

item.name: Upload post image
item.description: Multipart upload (jpeg/png/webp, 2 MB default limit). Returns 201 with imageId and a gated file URL. Stored privately; creates no post. Select a local image file for the file field before sending.

item.name: Read uploaded image
item.description: Uploader, moderator, or published-post readers only; otherwise 404. No-store response.

item.name: Like post
item.description: Only a Published post accepts reactions. A deleted/non-published parent returns 404 Community.PostNotFound; no reaction is persisted.

item.name: Unlike post
item.description: Unlike is also blocked when the parent is no longer Published (404); retained interaction rows are not cleaned up by post deletion and remain unchanged.

item.name: Toggle favorite
item.description: Only a Published post accepts a favorite mutation. A deleted/non-published parent returns 404 Community.PostNotFound; retained favorite rows are not cleaned up by post deletion.

item.name: Add or update rating
item.description: value is an integer from 1 to 5. Out-of-range or non-integer values return 400 Community.Rating.Invalid. Re-submitting updates the caller's rating.

item.name: Submit local-day check-in
item.description: One row per user/post/local date. Invalid time zones return Community.CheckIn.Invalid.

item.name: Get personalized recommendations
item.description: Authenticated read. Published posts only, affinity authors first, already-interacted posts excluded. No totalCount is returned. Same post shape as the posts feed, including the author fields displayName and avatarUrl (null for an anonymous post).

item.name: List comments
item.description: Bare list of the post's comments. Every item carries displayName (English full name, Arabic fallback, null when the identity row is missing), avatarUrl (the author's avatar download path /api/v1/community/authors/{authorId}/photo when the author has a stored avatar, else null) and isAnonymous. A comment written by the author of an anonymous post inside that post's own thread is anonymous: authorId, displayName and avatarUrl are null and isAnonymous is true. Every other comment carries its authorId.

item.name: Delete own comment
item.description: Deletion is blocked when the comment has replies.

item.name: Like comment
item.description: Comment likes are blocked when the comment's parent post is not Published; response is 404 and retained interaction rows stay unchanged.

item.name: List replies
item.description: Bare list of the comment's replies, same shape as the comment list: displayName, avatarUrl (the author's avatar download path when the author has a stored avatar, else null) and isAnonymous. A reply written by the author of an anonymous post inside that post's own thread is anonymous: authorId, displayName and avatarUrl are null.

item.name: Submit app rating
item.description: Authenticated identity is assigned by the server; rating must be 1–5.

item.name: List active categories
item.description: Authenticated read. Active categories only, ordered by creation time then id. Bare list of {id, arabicName, englishName}.

item.name: Block an author
item.description: One-way, hide-posts-only. The viewer is the authenticated identity; the target is named by author id only, and it must be a REGISTERED author id (take it from a non-anonymous post - an anonymous post never publishes its author id). Idempotent: a repeat succeeds (204) without a duplicate row. A self-block returns 400 Community.Block.Invalid; an unknown author id returns the generic privacy 404 (code Community.Block.NotFound). Only that author's POSTS are hidden from the caller - comments, replies, likes, ratings and check-ins are unchanged.

item.name: Unblock an author
item.description: Always 204, even when nothing was blocked; unblocking never reveals whether a block existed. Removing the relation restores the author's posts to the caller.

item.name: List blocked authors
item.description: The caller's own blocked authors, most-recent block first, paged. Bare list of {authorId, displayName, avatarUrl, blockedOnUtc}. displayName is the English full name with the Arabic fallback and is null when the identity row is missing; avatarUrl is the author's avatar download path (/api/v1/community/authors/{authorId}/photo) when the identity row carries a stored avatar, else null - never the stored private key. Never lists an author blocked by anyone else.

item.name: Get author avatar
item.description: Authenticated read. Streams the Community author's avatar image bytes (the S3 approved photo route, lock #32). Never returns the stored private avatar key. An unknown author, an author with no stored avatar, and an anonymous author all return the same generic 404 Community.Author.Photo.NotFound - anonymity is resolved server-side from the author's stored posts, so the request carries no anonymity hint.
